# Version 4.148.1 (Unreleased)
> **macOS typeface concurrency fix**

## Highlights

The next servicing release fixes a macOS typeface stream data race without changing the m148 engine baseline.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **macOS typeface stream synchronization** — An upstream m148 fix resolves a race between the typeface cache and stream access in the CoreText-backed typeface implementation. Managed APIs and the native ABI are unchanged. ([#4262](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4262))
